items.proposed: CDKN2A_B not a selection biomarker (exploratory_correlative / documentation only)
items.reason: The record requires only that 'CDKN2A/B status ... must be confirmed' for Part 2, with no required value, so it is not an entry requirement for a particular status (manual §5: eligibility/enrichment only if required to enter). Coder B's non-selecting coding stands; no effect on outcomes (IDH eligibility already present).

note: Trial fails S5 (IDH1-mutant glioma only; 'Astrocytoma, Grade IV' in conditions is IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma, not glioblastoma under CNS5). tumour_pk_planned (priority 3 row) proposed 'unclear' per W7: Parts 2/3 list 'Safusidenib PK Profile: Defined as safusidenib concentrations and PK parameters' with no sample type. Part 2 1p/19q-absence/ATRX-loss and Part 3 1p/19q-codeletion requirements are cohort enrichment (unmatched); no outcome effect.
